description_en: Queries the details of an instance node
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-node-detail --collaboration-group-id group_example --instance-id plan_example --node-id step_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNodeDetail

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

agentWorkProcess.description_en: The actual work process grouped by thoughts, skills, tools, replies, and artifacts
agentWorkProcess.description_zh: 按思考、技能、工具、回复和产物分组的实际工作过程

artifacts.description_en: The artifacts: saved node work records and artifacts
artifacts.description_zh: artifacts：已保存的节点工作记录/产物

items.description_en: The summaries and stable references of the node artifacts, which are consistent with the top-level artifacts. This is an empty list if no artifacts exist
items.description_zh: 节点产物摘要与稳定引用，与顶层artifacts一致；无产物时为空列表

artifactId.description_en: The registered artifact ID. This parameter may be empty for artifacts derived only from the result summary
artifactId.description_zh: 登记产物ID；仅来自结果摘要的产物可能为空

artifactKey.description_en: The unique key of the artifact in the node result
artifactKey.description_zh: 产物在节点结果中的唯一key

additionalProperties.description_en: The stable reference of the artifact, including kind, id, and url. The URL of a registered artifact is a re-authentication entry point and can be empty
additionalProperties.description_zh: 产物稳定引用，包含kind、id、url；登记产物URL为重新鉴权入口，可为空

ref.description_en: The stable reference of the artifact, including kind, id, and url. The URL of a registered artifact is a re-authentication entry point and can be empty
ref.description_zh: 产物稳定引用，包含kind、id、url；登记产物URL为重新鉴权入口，可为空

summary.description_en: The artifact summary, excluding inline content

title.description_en: The display title of the artifact

replies.description_en: The replies: saved node work records and artifacts
replies.description_zh: replies：已保存的节点工作记录/产物

items.description_zh: 已保存的回复记录，action为REPLY；无记录时为空列表

action.description_en: The record type. Valid values: THINK, REPLY, TOOL_CALL, SKILL_CALL, or ARTIFACT

detail.description_en: The saved original record content. Tool invocation and artifact metadata are JSON strings
detail.description_zh: 已保存的原始记录内容；工具调用与产物元数据为JSON字符串

duration.description_en: The time taken for this work record, in milliseconds. The value is 0 for artifact records
duration.description_zh: 该条工作记录耗时，单位毫秒；产物记录为0

nodeId.description_en: The key of the parent node, not the conversation ID

attemptSeq.description_en: The sequence number of the node execution attempt

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

conversationId.description_en: The node conversation ID. This parameter is empty if no conversation is created
conversationId.description_zh: 节点会话ID，未创建时为空

conversationWritable.description_zh: 当前节点会话是否可以继续输入

result.description_zh: 节点结果摘要，不含inline正文

resumePending.description_en: Indicates whether there are pending follow-up turns to be dispatched

runLog.description_zh: runLog：已保存的节点工作记录/产物

todoIds.description_zh: 当前节点关联的待办ID列表

items.description_zh: 当前节点关联的待办ID列表，元素为待办ID字符串

turnSeq.description_en: The sequence number of the conversation turn in the current attempt
turnSeq.description_zh: 当前尝试的对话轮序号

waitType.description_en: The reason why the node is waiting. This parameter is empty if the node is not waiting
waitType.description_zh: 节点等待原因，未等待时为空
